newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends lower on expected import deals.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends lower on expected import deals.

text.p: The won fell against the dollar on Friday as banks prepared for huge import deals scheduled for early next week, brokers said.
The won closed at an intra-day low of 819.10, after opening at a high of 817.60.
"The dollar was bullish because of the settlements scheduled on Monday and Tuesday," said a foreign bank dealer.
"But the central bank is expected to step in if the dollar breaks 820," said a local bank dealer.
Without such intervention, the domestic currency could fall to as low as 825, he said.
The won's trading range on Monday was seen at 818.50-820.00, they said.
Monday's base mid-rate was expected to be pegged at 818.60, against Friday's 818.10.
